author: nc1234
content: Just throwing out some random idea: if we really want to reduce the overlap among the ILs, CL can pass its position in the ILC to engine api, and EL uses it to pick transactions that `tx_hash % 16 == position in IL committee` or something. This position can also be used as source of randomness. But I still think a portion of the IL should still be ranked by priority fee so we dont degrade the payload quality too much

author: potuz
content: The EL itself can pick some randomness without the need for an API though

author: jih2nn
content: FYI, this is what <@348512261955911691> proposed nearly two years ago. It was not adopted because it was too early to commit to some specific coordination at that point of time.
